data.exact_reserve_text:
The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 8.2m in respect of reserves set in prior years (2020: deterioration of GBP 1.7m).
In 2021, there has been an overall deficit in ultimate claims of GBP 15.8m (2020: deficit of GBP 2.0m) due primarily to an increase in US Winter storm Uri of GBP 8.4m on the 2020 year of account and a general increase in non-catastrophe claims estimates.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2021 the syndicate's prior years showed adverse reserve development: gross prior-year reserves (primarily 2019 and earlier) increased leading to a prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 2.19m (c.14.3% of opening gross claims outstanding). The deterioration reflects adverse claims development largely driven by US catastrophe losses and large loss development (notably the impact of US severe weather events tied to the 2020 underwriting year) together with broader non-catastrophe claim estimate increases.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 8.2m in respect of reserves set in prior years (2020: deterioration of GBP 1.7m).

In 2021, there has been an overall deficit in ultimate claims of GBP 15.8m (2020: deficit of GBP 2.0m) due primarily to an increase in US Winter storm Uri of GBP 8.4m on the 2020 year of account and a general increase in non-catastrophe claims estimates.
The syndicate has material exposure to Hurricane Ida. The current ultimate estimated losses for Hurricane Ida are gross and net $39.2m.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2021). Prior-year development gross figure was derived from the published gross claims development triangle (comparison of 2019 column current estimate vs previous diagonal) because no explicit gross 'movement in prior years' line was provided; the report also quotes a net deterioration of GBP 8.2m (net of reinsurance) for prior years. Some event loss amounts quoted in the report are in USD (market and syndicate USD $m figures) and have not been converted. RITC transactions and commutations are mentioned elsewhere and may distort comparisons; the triangle was used with caution.
